description: This Java class defines a service for managing notification email queues in a Spring Boot application. It includes methods for enqueuing notifications, listing recent queued items, and processing the queue periodically. The class handles email sending via JavaMailSender, supports retry logic, and logs actions accordingly.

classes.name: NotificationQueueService
classes.description: Service class providing enqueue and background processing of email notifications, supporting configuration, retry logic, and scheduled processing.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueue a new email notification request with recipient, subject, body, and optional schedule time.

methods.name: listRecent
methods.description: List the most recent queued notifications up to a specified limit.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Periodically process the queued notifications, attempting to send pending emails.

methods.name: attemptSend
methods.description: Attempt to send a notification; if mail is disabled, simulate sending, handle failures, and update status.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Handle failure during sending, updating retry count and status, scheduling retries if within max retries.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncate a string to a specified length, appending an ellipsis if truncated.
